answer: A governance gate is a measured threshold a model must clear before it is treated as ready for a given use. It is not an opinion: it is a pass/fail verdict produced by a fixed, repeatable evaluation on a signed board, recorded as an Ed25519-signed manifest so the verdict cannot be silently altered. Gates are a verified measurement credential — they state what was measured and the observed observation regime, not a claim of provable isolation. A published gate value is only honest when the underlying run and bank are open to re-measurement.
